body.name: Randomized shared-law regret and minimax correspondence
body.construction: Let \(\Delta_{\mathcal M}=\{\delta\in\mathbb R_+^{|\mathcal M|}:\sum_{m\in\mathcal M}\delta_m=1\}\). A draw \(m\sim\delta\), made independently of the latent law, incurs loss \(\sum_m\delta_m v_m\) at \(v\in\mathcal V(p_{BT},q)\). Define its shared-law worst-case regret and the randomized minimax correspondence by \(\mathcal R(\delta)=\sup_{v\in\mathcal V(p_{BT},q)}\{\sum_m\delta_m v_m-\min_{j\in\mathcal M}v_j\}\) and \(\Delta^\star=\operatorname*{argmin}_{\delta\in\Delta_{\mathcal M}}\mathcal R(\delta)\).
